summary: Iteration 2 re-tested after fixes. Backend: all 20 pytest tests pass (14 trips CRUD + 6 new routing/excel tests). Frontend: GPS button now on both origin and destination (both fill 'lat,lng' via mocked geolocation). LegsSummary works end-to-end: input-trip-date defaults to today, btn-calculate-legs returns leg-row-1 + total km/time (Milano->Firenze ~302.6 km / 3h18min), editing route shows legs-stale-warning, empty origin triggers toast error, btn-export-excel downloads 'tratte_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx' with correct headers and SUM formulas. Mobile 390px regression: action bar is now pinned to viewport bottom (rect.bottom=844==winH; no transformed ancestor). .fade-up CSS now only animates opacity (fadeIn keyframes), so no containing block issue. Save/load/delete regression quick-check also works via existing APIs (CRUD tests cover persistence).
critical_code_review_comments: routing.py uses an in-process _geo_cache dict and _geo_lock (asyncio.Lock) + 1s sleep inside the lock to honor Nominatim's 1 req/s policy. OK for single-worker uvicorn, but if backend scales to multiple workers/pods the rate limit could be violated. Consider a shared cache (Redis) or external geocoder for production.
LegsSummary.body() recomputes JSON.stringify on every render for the stale-key — acceptable for current size but could be memoized.

Excel row order relies on hardcoded header row index 4 and legs starting at row 5; the SUM formula ranges are built off ws.max_row before appending the totals row (correct), but any future header addition will silently break the formula ranges. Add a constant for the data start row.
GpsButton error message surfaces raw browser error strings — acceptable, but a user-friendly mapping for PERMISSION_DENIED / POSITION_UNAVAILABLE / TIMEOUT would be nicer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all tested flows pass incl. mobile fixed action bar)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests use TEST_ prefix with teardown fixture; cleanup verified (0 remaining TEST_ trips after run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing tests use coord-only (fast path) + one real Nominatim call to Milano/Bologna/Firenze (cached server-side after first run). If you re-run, Nominatim calls take ~1-2s each due to rate-limiting sleep. Excel content verified via openpyxl (headers, title, TOTALE row, SUM formulas). Frontend playwright script in iteration_2 history mocks geolocation via context.set_geolocation + grant_permissions.
